description: This file defines the ExtractMetadataRetriever class and related classes for extracting metadata from documents using vector stores and language models. It includes class definitions, constructor logic, and methods for retrieving relevant documents based on structured prompts.

classes.name: ExtractMetadataRetriever_Retrievers
classes.description: Implements a retriever node for extracting metadata from queries and documents, supporting structured output and integration with vector stores.

classes.name: DynamicMetadataRetriever
classes.description: Extends VectorStoreRetriever to fetch relevant documents based on structured metadata obtained via a language model.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the retriever with provided node data and input, configuring structured output and fetching relevant documents or text.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Invokes the structured language model to generate a filter based on the query.

methods.name: getRelevantDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves documents from the vector store that match the filter generated from the query.

methods.name: fromVectorStore
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of DynamicMetadataRetriever from a vector store and options.
